XenotypeDef.label: Valyrian
XenotypeDef.description: An ancient Valyrian bloodline, known for pale skin, silver hair, violet eyes and remarkable beauty. In Valyria it is chiefly found among lords, ladies and the higher nobility.\n\nAdults inherit a standard male or female build and an average-width head. Consenting adult blood relatives may form romantic relationships without the usual kinship taboo; attraction and inherited pregnancy risks still apply.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Pale, silver-haired, violet-eyed and beautiful hereditary nobility.

GeneDef.label: Valyrian pale skin
GeneDef.description: The pale, softly white complexion associated with old Valyrian blood. A change in appearance only, with no added sensitivity to sunlight.

GeneDef.label: Valyrian silver hair
GeneDef.description: Carriers have naturally silver-white hair that retains its color with age.

GeneDef.label: Valyrian purple eyes
GeneDef.description: Violet irises, a striking sign of Valyrian ancestry. Visible eye color is supported by the optional [NL] Facial Animation and UNAGI packs.

GeneDef.label: Valyrian form
GeneDef.description: This bloodline favors a standard male or female build and an average-width head in adulthood, rather than thin, fat, hulk or unusually shaped forms. Children keep bodies appropriate to their age.

GeneDef.label: Valyrian kinship
GeneDef.description: Blood ties do not stand in the way of a consenting adult romance among carriers of this bloodline. Both partners must be at least 18 biological years old; attraction, acceptance and marriage remain matters of choice. Inherited pregnancy risks are unchanged, and eligible adult kin couples do not face disapproval from other carriers.
